sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A LARGE UPPER TROUGH WILL RESIDE ACROSS THE WRN CONUS DURING THE D1 FORECAST PERIOD...WHILE DOWNSTREAM...AN UPPER RIDGE WILL BE PRESENT FROM THE MO VALLEY INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY. A SHORTWAVE TROUGH LOCATED OVER THE NRN ROCKIES EARLY THIS MORNING WILL LIFT NWD AROUND THE ERN EDGE OF THE LARGER-SCALE WAVE INTO CANADA BY LATE MORNING. AS THIS OCCURS...A SURFACE LOW PRESSURE SYSTEM WILL OCCLUDE...WITH A COLD FRONT/OCCLUDED FRONT ARCING NWWD FROM THE DAKOTAS INTO SRN ALBERTA...AND A WARM FRONT EXTENDING SEWD FROM CNTRL ND INTO E-CNTRL MN. THE SRN PORTION OF THE COLD FRONT WILL THEN TRAIL SWWD INTO THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS...WHERE A SECOND AREA OF LOW PRESSURE IS FORECAST TO RESIDE LATER IN THE AFTERNOON.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL PLAINS AND UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: A BROAD AREA OF SLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL AID IN TRANSPORTING MID 60S DEWPOINTS INTO THE NRN PLAINS AND UPPER MS VALLEY AHEAD OF THE SURFACE OCCLUDED/COLD FRONT...WITH UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS POSSIBLE OVER ERN NEB AND WRN IA. BY MIDDAY...AN EML IS FORECAST TO SPREAD ACROSS THE AREA...WITH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES COMBINED WITH SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE 80S AND A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AIDING IN MLCAPE VALUES AOA 2000 J/KG. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES UPPER FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL BE NEBULOUS THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON...WITH WEAK/SUBTLE MIDLEVEL VORTICITY MAXIMA EJECTING NEWD FROM THE WRN TROUGH. HOWEVER...CURRENT THINKING IS AN MCV EMANATING FROM AN MCS OVER ERN MT EARLY THIS MORNING WILL ROUND THE UPPER RIDGE AND AID IN RENEWED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT BY AFTERNOON ALONG AND N OF THE WARM FRONT OVER ERN ND AND NRN/CNTRL MN. THIS ACTIVITY MAY QUICKLY GROW UPSCALE INTO ANOTHER MCS AND MOVE SEWD ALONG THE WARM FRONT. DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS...BUT A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE. MCS MAINTENANCE WILL CONTINUE TO BE SUPPORTED INTO THE NIGHT AS A SWLY LOW-LEVEL JET STRENGTHENS AND EXPANDS NWD INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY. ELSEWHERE OVER SD INTO NEB

sections.title: WRN NEB/NEB PANHANDLE...FAR SERN WY
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE FORECAST TO BE OUT OF THE E OVER WRN NEB AS A COLD FRONT STALLS OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. THIS WILL AID IN MAINTAINING A MOIST LOW-LEVEL AIRMASS OVER THE NEB PANHANDLE/FAR SERN WY...WITH SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S...AND WILL SUPPORT WEAK TO MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH THE OCCURRENCE OF DAYTIME HEATING AND THE PRESENCE OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES. THUS...A FEW ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS CANNOT BE RULED OUT WITHIN THE UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME. IF THIS OCCURS...SHEAR PROFILES WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS POSING A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO. HOWEVER...THIS SCENARIO IS UNCERTAIN ATTM...WHICH PRECLUDES A CATEGORICAL UPGRADE. THE MORE LIKELY SCENARIO IS FOR STORMS TO DEVELOP OVERNIGHT AS AN UPPER IMPULSE EJECTS EWD INTO THE HIGH PLAINS. THESE STORMS WOULD LIKELY BE ELEVATED AND POSE AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: ERN NM...W TX/TX PANHANDLE
sections.text: DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S TO NEAR 60F ARE FORECAST TO RESIDE OVER THE SRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON IN THE PRESENCE OF STRONG SURFACE HEATING AND STEEP LAPSE RATES. THIS WILL YIELD MODERATE INSTABILITY SUPPORTIVE OF THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS...WITH STORM INITIATION POSSIBLY AIDED BY A WEAK UPPER IMPULSE ENTERING THE REGION BY EVENING. ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THIS ENVIRONMENT. ..GARNER/MOSIER.. 06/20/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN INITIALLY ELONGATED UPPER LOW STRETCHING FROM JUST OFF THE WA/SRN BC COAST TO THE NRN ROCKIES WILL CONTRACT AND GRADUALLY DEEPEN OVER THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION AS A SERIES OF VORTICITY MAXIMA PIVOT AROUND THE PARENT SYSTEM. THE MOST PROMINENT VORTICITY LOBE /IN THE FORM OF A NEGATIVELY TILTED SHORTWAVE TROUGH/ OVER CNTRL/ERN MT WILL ROTATE NWD INTO SRN PARTS OF SK/AB WHILE ANOTHER UPSTREAM IMPULSE/JET STREAK TRANSLATES FROM THE PACIFIC NW COASTAL WATERS INTO NRN PARTS OF CA/NV AND SERN ORE BY 21/12Z. IN THE WAKE OF THE NRN HIGH PLAINS SHORT-WAVE TROUGH...MIDLEVEL HEIGHTS WILL REBOUND SLIGHTLY ACROSS LOWER ELEVATIONS OF THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS...ON THE NRN PERIPHERY OF AN UPPER HIGH CENTERED OVER THE SRN PLAINS. IN THE LOW LEVELS...ONGOING STORMS ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS INTO UPPER MS VALLEY WILL MODULATE THE POSITION OF SURFACE BOUNDARIES TODAY. IN GENERAL...IT APPEARS THAT A PACIFIC FRONT WILL ADVANCE EWD INTO THE CNTRL DAKOTAS BY AFTERNOON...STRETCHING FROM AN OCCLUDING LOW OVER SRN SK TO A DEEPENING LEE CYCLONE OVER THE TRI-STATE REGION OF CO/NEB/KS. A WARM FRONT /REINFORCED BY CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW/ WILL LIE W-E FROM IT/S INTERSECTION WITH THE PACIFIC FRONT INTO NRN OR CNTRL PARTS

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW WILL BE ENHANCED INTO THE CHEYENNE RIDGE ALONG/JUST N OF SEWD-SETTLING PACIFIC FRONT AND TO THE NORTH OF DEEPENING LEE LOW. THIS LOW-LEVEL FORCING WILL BE OFFSET BY SLIGHT HEIGHT RISES...WHICH SHOULD LIMIT THE COVERAGE OF AFTERNOON/EVENING TSTM DEVELOPMENT TO ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED. GIVEN THE COMBINATION OF STEEP LAPSE RATES...MLCAPE UP TO 2000-3000 J/KG...AND 35-45 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...THE SETUP WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL BEING THE PRIMARY RISK.

sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS WILL ONCE AGAIN BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE DRYLINE/LEE DRYLINE. HERE...STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL ALIGN WITH MODEST AMOUNTS OF BOUNDARY MOISTURE AND VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SOME STORM ORGANIZATION WITH A THREAT FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL THROUGH THIS EVENING.

sections.title: FL THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: 12Z SOUNDINGS REVEAL A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER BENEATH SEASONABLY COOL MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES WHICH SHOULD YIELD A MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS BY AFTERNOON. SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP LATER TODAY ALONG EVOLVING SEA-BREEZE CIRCULATIONS. AN ISOLATED SEVERE STORM OR TWO IS POSSIBLE GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY AND HIGH PW ENVIRONMENT. ..MEAD/COHEN.. 06/20/2013

sections.title: NRN PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A CLOSED MIDLEVEL LOW WILL PERSIST OVER THE NRN ROCKIES THROUGH THE PERIOD WITH LITTLE EWD PROGRESSION ANTICIPATED. AN INITIAL EMBEDDED SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS ROTATING NWD INTO SRN ALBERTA/SASKATCHEWAN...WHILE OTHER MORE SUBTLE SPEED MAXIMA ROTATE NEWD FROM THE GREAT BASIN/CENTRAL ROCKIES TO THE NRN PLAINS...AROUND THE SERN PERIPHERY OF THE CLOSED LOW. AT THE SURFACE...A LOW NEAR SD/ND BORDER AS OF 15Z WILL WEAKEN AND THE COLD FRONT WILL SLOW ITS EWD MOTION AS THE PRIMARY SHORTWAVE TROUGH ROTATES INTO THE CANADIAN PRAIRIES. FARTHER S...A SECONDARY LEE CYCLONE WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP IN NE CO ALONG THE SRN EXTENSION OF THE COLD FRONT. WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR...A SWATH OF UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S DEWPOINTS WILL CONTINUE TO SURGE NWD FROM THE SRN/CENTRAL PLAINS...WITH THE NE EDGE OF THE GREATER INSTABILITY DEMARCATED BY AN OUTFLOW-ENHANCED WARM FRONT ACROSS SW MN/NE SD. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS SOME CLOUD BREAKS ACROSS S CENTRAL ND INTO CENTRAL SD IMMEDIATELY IN ADVANCE OF THE SURFACE LOW/COLD FRONT...WHERE BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE THROUGH THE MID 60S THIS AFTERNOON AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES WARM INTO THE UPPER 70S-LOWER 80S. STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES PRESEN

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS LATE THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WILL INCREASE BENEATH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES TO THE IMMEDIATE E-NE OF THE DEVELOPING LEE CYCLONE IN NE CO. THE STEEP LAPSE RATES ARE PART OF A WARM ELEVATED MIXED LAYER WITH 700 MB TEMPERATURES OF 14-16 C...BUT STRONG SURFACE HEATING/MIXING AND LIFT ALONG THE SURFACE FRONT SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO WEAKEN THE CAP AND ALLOW THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT BY LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS SW NEB AND VICINITY. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN SEVERE RISKS.

sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: STRONG SURFACE HEATING/MIXING ALONG THE LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE SHOULD SUPPORT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT AGAIN THIS AFTERNOON FROM SE NM INTO THE TX PANHANDLE. THE WEAK 500 MB FLOW NOTED IN THE 12Z SOUNDINGS FROM MAF/AMA REFLECT THE WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR THAT IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON. ISOLATED MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND STRONG OUTFLOW GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE...THE RISK FOR PERSISTENT/ ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS APPEARS LOW AND WILL MAINTAIN LOW HAIL/WIND PROBABILITIES.

sections.title: INTERIOR CENTRAL/S FL THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: WEAK LOW-MIDLEVEL FLOW WILL PROMOTE INLAND MOVEMENT OF BOTH THE E AND W COAST SEA BREEZES THIS AFTERNOON. THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED ALONG BOTH COASTS WITH OUTFLOWS AUGMENTING THE INLAND MOVEMENT OF THE EACH SEA BREEZE BOUNDARY. GIVEN THE POTENTIAL FOR MODERATE INSTABILITY INLAND WITH SEASONABLY COOL MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES...STORM MERGERS COULD SUPPORT ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE DOWNBURSTS AND SOME HAIL. ..THOMPSON/BUNTING.. 06/20/2013

sections.title: DAKOTAS/UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: LITTLE CHANGES TO FORECASTING REASONING/RISK AREAS...ALTHOUGH CORRIDOR OF HIGHER /30 PERCENT/ WIND PROBABILITIES WERE ADJUSTED A BIT SOUTHWARD ACROSS THE REGION FOR EXPECTED MCS DEVELOPMENT LATER THIS EVENING. OTHERWISE...SEE PRIOR DISCUSSION BELOW...AND FOR ADDITIONAL NEAR-TERM INFORMATION THIS AFTERNOON...SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1141.

sections.title: SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: SEE PRIOR OUTLOOK DISCUSSION IN ADDITION TO MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1140. ..GUYER.. 06/20/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1135 AM CDT THU JUN 20 2013/

sections.title: DAKOTAS/UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: EVENING MESOANALYSIS PLACES AN AREA OF SURFACE LOW PRESSURE OVER FAR S-CNTRL ND INTO CNTRL SD...WITH A WARM FRONT EXTENDING EWD INTO FAR SERN ND...AND THEN SEWD INTO E-CNTRL MN. MLCAPE VALUES FROM 2000-3500 J/KG RESIDE ALONG THE WARM FRONT...WITH VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES ALONG AND N OF THE BOUNDARY FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS. LARGE HAIL /SOME SIG/ WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO...AS WELL AS A TORNADO ALONG AND IMMEDIATELY N OF THE FRONT WHERE LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE BACKED OUT OF THE SE. UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR TONIGHT AS STORMS INCREASE IN COVERAGE IN RESPONSE TO A STRENGTHENING LLJ IMPINGING UPON THE WARM FRONT. MOTION IS FORECAST TO BE TOWARD THE SE...WITH AN ASSOCIATED DAMAGING WIND THREAT SPREADING ACROSS CNTRL MN INTO WRN WI. ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS ARE ALSO DEVELOPING ALONG A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL BOUNDARY OVER NRN/CNTRL SD. AIRMASS OVER THIS AREA IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN THE 80S AND DEEP BOUNDARY LAYER MIXING. LARGE MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 3500 J/KG AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT A LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. SEWD INTO ERN NEB AND IA...VISIBLE SATEL

sections.title: NEB PANHANDLE...ERN WY...WRN SD
sections.text: A FRONTAL BOUNDARY HAS STALLED FROM NERN CO INTO CNTRL SD. SURFACE WINDS N OF THE BOUNDARY ARE BECOMING ELY...WHICH IS ALLOWING 40S AND 50S DEWPOINTS TO BACK WWD INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE AND FAR SERN WY. AN ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM MAY FORM WITHIN THIS UPSLOPE REGIME EARLY TONIGHT...WITH MODERATELY STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR NEAR 50 KT AND MLCAPE VALUES FROM 500-1500 J/KG SUPPORTING A SUPERCELL MODE POSING A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL. NAM AND HRRR MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATE MOISTURE WILL SURGE WNWWD INTO ERN WY AND WRN SD LATER TONIGHT AS AN UPPER IMPULSE MOVES FROM THE GREAT BASIN TOWARD THE SRN/CNTRL ROCKIES. AS THIS OCCURS...MUCAPE VALUES EXCEEDING 1000 J/KG WILL BE POSSIBLE GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES. ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS ROOTED SLIGHTLY ABOVE THE SURFACE WILL BE POSSIBLE AS A RESULT...WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES FROM 50-60 KT SUPPORTING STORM ORGANIZATION/ROTATION AND A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL. GIVEN THE HIGHER PROBABILITY FOR STORM INITIATION OVER ERN WY/WRN SD...THE SLIGHT RISK DELINEATION HAS BEEN ADJUSTED NWD.

sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS THIS EVENING
sections.text: CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS OCCURRING FROM THE TX PANHANDLE SWWD INTO ERN NM AND FAR W TX WILL POSE A RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO. HOWEVER...LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING WILL RESULT IN WEAKENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND INCREASING CINH...WHICH IS EXPECTED TO LEAD TO STORM DISSIPATION WITH TIME. ..GARNER.. 06/21/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SVR TSTMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE POSSIBLE THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THIS AFTERNOON. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED GIVEN THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE SEVERE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG DAYTIME HEATING HAS RESULTED IN A HOT/DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS PORTIONS OF SERN NM AND FAR W TX. WITH MLCAPES GENERALLY BETWEEN 1500 AND 2000 J/KG AND MODEST LOW-MID TROPOSPHERIC FLOW...EXPECT ISOLATED STRONGER TSTMS TO POSE A SVR THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS GIVEN THE VERY LOW SUB-CLOUD RH VALUES. RELATIVELY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ALSO SUGGEST LARGE HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS. THE OVERALL SVR THREAT SHOULD REMAIN SUFFICIENTLY ISOLATED THAT A WW WILL NOT BE NEEDED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INITIATE OVER SCNTRL ND AND POSSIBLY INTO NCNTRL SD BY 22Z. SUPERCELLS ARE LIKELY WITH INITIAL STORMS...BUT ACTIVITY MAY EVENTUALLY GROW UPSCALE INTO AN MCS AS IT DEVELOPS EWD. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND SHOULD BE THE MAIN THREATS...BUT A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WARM FRONT EXTENDS FROM WEAK SFC LOW NEAR MCINTOSH ALONG THE SD/ND BORDER EWD ACROSS SRN ND AND CNTRL MN. A COLD FRONT AND PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH STRETCHES SWD FROM THE LOW THROUGH WRN SD. THE ATMOSPHERE IS DESTABILIZING NEAR AND SOUTH OF WARM FRONT WHERE DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE UPPER 60S AND TEMPERATURES CLIMBING THROUGH THE 80S. SOME CAP LIKELY STILL EXISTS BASED ON THE CHARACTER OF LOW CLOUDS OVER SRN ND...AND 12Z RAOB FROM BISMARK SUGGESTS TEMPERATURES IN THE UPPER 80S ARE NEEDED TO SIGNIFICANTLY WEAKEN CONVECTIVE INHIBITION. FURTHER DIABATIC WARMING AND PERSISTENT CONVERGENCE IN VICINITY OF THE TRIPLE POINT AND WARM FRONT SHOULD PROMOTE SURFACE BASED STORM INITIATION OVER SCNTRL ND WITHIN NEXT COUPLE HOURS. WINDS ARE MODEST WITHIN THE LOWEST 2 KM...BUT 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS AS INITIAL STORM MODES WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THE MAIN THREATS. HODOGRAPHS ARE RELATIVELY SMALL...BUT A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT MAINLY WITH ANY STORM INTERACTING WITH THE WARM FRONT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS SERN ND IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AND EVENTUALLY SPREAD SWD INTO NERN SD AND EWD INTO CNTRL MN. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED TO THE EAST OF THE CURRENT WATCH LATER THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A 1005 MB LOW IN WCNTRL SD WITH A WARM FRONT EXTENDING ENEWD ACROSS FAR SE ND INTO CNTRL MN. AN INVERTED SFC TROUGH IS LOCATED ACROSS WCNTRL ND. CELLS ARE DEVELOPING FROM THE SFC TROUGH NEWD ACROSS ERN ND WHERE SFC WINDS ARE BACKED AND LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS ENHANCED. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THE ACTIVITY IN ERN ND MAY BE ELEVATED AND SHOULD CONTAIN HAIL DUE TO STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. A WIND DAMAGE THREAT MAY BE MORE PROMINENT WITH THE SFC-BASED STORMS TO THE EAST OF BISMARK. SHORT-TERM MODEL FORECASTS DEVELOP NEW THUNDERSTORMS FROM FARGO ND SWD TO EAST OF ABERDEEN SD EARLY THIS EVENING. THE MODELS APPEAR TO ORGANIZE A LINE OF STORMS AND MOVE THIS FEATURE INTO WRN AND CNTRL MN LATER THIS EVENING. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY THREATS BUT A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO CAN NOT BE RULED OUT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SVR TSTMS ARE POSSIBLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF FAR ERN CO...WRN KS...AND THE OK PANHANDLE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. PRIMARY THREAT IS SVR WIND/HAIL. COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO BE TOO LOW TO MERIT WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY REVEALS AN AREA OF TCU ALONG THE SRN CO/KS BORDER TO THE E OF A LEE LOW ACROSS SE CO. ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THIS AREA IS VERY WELL MIXED WITH TEMPERATURES IN THE MID 90S AND DEWPOINTS AROUND 60 DEG F. SPC MESOANALYSIS INDICATES MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IN EXCESS OF 8.5 DEG C PER KM...SUPPORTING A MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT /MLCAPE IN EXCESS OF 2500 J PER KG PER MESOANALYSIS/. HOWEVER...MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES REMAIN WARM... WITH 700 MB TEMPS GENERALLY ESTIMATED AROUND 16 DEG C. AS SUCH...DESPITE THE DEEP MIXING...SOME CINH LIKELY REMAINS...ESPECIALLY FOR A ML PARCEL. CONTINUED MIXING IS EXPECTED TO SUPPORT ISOLATED TSTM DEVELOPMENT. GIVEN THE INSTABILITY...ANY STORM THAT DOES DEVELOP WILL LIKELY BECOME SEVERE WITH PRIMARY THREATS OF DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. OVERALL STORM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN TOO LOW TO MERIT WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE ACROSS CNTRL MN AND NW WI THIS EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NECESSARY WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING TO THE NORTHEAST OF A WARM FRONT IN SERN ND AND WCNTRL MN. THIS ACTIVITY WILL EXPAND ESEWD ACROSS CNTRL MN OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS AS A 30 TO 40 KT LOW-LEVEL JET STRENGTHENS AND NOSES INTO SW MN. THE STRENGTHENING FLOW SHOULD ALSO HELP DESTABILIZE THE AIRMASS. THIS COMBINED WITH 40 TO 45 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOULD SUPPORT SEVERE STORMS. LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE AS STORMS ORGANIZE ACROSS WRN PARTS OF THE MCD AREA THIS EVENING. IN ADDITION...OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SUGGESTS THAT THE CAP HAS WEAKENED ACROSS ERN SD WHICH MAY ALLOW FOR NEW CELLS TO INITIATE IN NERN SD AND MOVE EWD INTO SCNTRL MN. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD ALSO HAVE A SEVERE THREAT. OTHER STORMS PERSISTING ALONG THE WARM FRONT/OUTFLOW IN NW WI...WILL CONTINUE TO HAVE AN ISOLATED HAIL THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT ASSOCIATED WITH A DEVELOPING MCS OVER SERN ND WILL LIKELY CONTINUE BEYOND THE 03Z WATCH EXPIRATION. FOR THIS REASON...LOCAL EXTENSIONS WILL BE DONE TO EXTEND WW 331 IN TIME. PER COORDINATION...ABERDEEN AND GRAND FORKS WILL EXTEND UNTIL 05Z WHILE BISMARK WILL EXTEND UNTIL 04Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE OVER THE UPPER MS VALLEY. THIS FEATURE HAS MOVED EWD THIS EVENING WHICH IS LIKELY INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ACROSS THE DAKOTAS. THIS COMBINED WITH MODERATE INSTABILITY IS LIKELY SUPPORTING A DEVELOPING MCS IN THE CNTRL AND NRN PART OF WW 331. THE MCS WILL LIKELY MOVE SEWD ALONG THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT ACROSS NERN SD INTO WRN AND CNTRL MN OVERNIGHT. THE INSTABILITY AND MODERATE DEEP LAYER SHEAR IN PLACE WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LARGE COMPLEX OF STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IN THE FORM OF LOCALLY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WHILE SPREADING EAST ACROSS CENTRAL MN OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MCS CONVECTIVE CONSOLIDATION PHASE NOW APPEARS TO BE UNDERWAY NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF ND/SD/MN BORDERS. VIGOROUS DEEP CONVECTION CONTINUES ALONG AND PRIMARILY NORTH OF A QUASI-STATIONARY/WARM FRONT THAT EXTENDS FROM THE ND/SD BORDER EAST INTO WRN WI. WHILE STORMS UNDERGO MERGERS AND COLD POOL STRENGTHENS ACROSS THE ND/MN BORDER AREA...MID LEVEL WLY FLOW HAS ALSO INCREASED TO ABOUT 50KT INTO THE BACKSIDE OF THE DEVELOPING MCS PER ABR VWP DATA. LOW LEVEL JET HAS ALSO STRENGTHENED TO ABOUT 40KT ACROSS IA AND SRN MN. MASS INFLOW AND LIFT ACROSS THE WARM FRONT...IN CONCERT WITH DEEP-LAYER SPEED AND DIRECTIONAL SHEAR...SHOULD ACT TO MAINTAIN A FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS WITH BOTH HAIL AND WIND HAZARDS CONTINUING ESEWD ACROSS WW332. SOME REGENERATIVE CONVECTION APPEARS LIKELY TO OCCUR ALONG THE SWRN FLANK OF THE EVOLVING COMPLEX...FROM NERN SD ACROSS CNTRL AND PERHAPS SWRN MN WITH TIME. REFER TO MESOSCALE PRECIPITATION DISCUSSION 0114 FROM WPC FOR DETAILS REGARDING CONVECTIVE HEAVY RAINFALL POTENTIAL. ..CARBIN.. 06/21/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A WELL ESTABLISHED BOWING LINE OF TSTMS LOCATED IN CENTRAL MN WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS...SOME SIGNIFICANT GUSTS POSSIBLE...AS THIS ACTIVITY MOVES THROUGH EAST CENTRAL MN TO FAR WEST CENTRAL WI /INCLUDING THE TWIN CITIES METRO AREA/ BETWEEN 08-0930Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0750Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A BOWING LINE OF STORMS EXTENDING FROM BENTON COUNTY THROUGH WRIGHT TO SRN MEEKER COUNTIES...WITH THE TRAILING PORTION OF THE LINE EXTENDING WSWWD TO YELLOW MEDICINE COUNTY MN AND DEUEL COUNTY SD. THE BOWING PORTION OF THIS LINE WAS MOVING E/SEWD AT 40-45 KT AND HAD A COLD POOL IN ITS WAKE...WHILE INBOUND RADAR VELOCITIES AT 2500 FEET AGL WERE AROUND 80 KT. THE BOW WAS TRACKING E/SEWD ALONG AND JUST S OF A WARM FRONT WHICH EXTENDED FROM WRIGHT THROUGH ANOKA COUNTIES INTO EAU CLAIRE AND SRN CLARK COUNTIES WI. SLY WINDS IN THE WARM SECTOR WERE MAINTAINING A MOIST ENVIRONMENT WITH GRADUAL DESTABILIZATION ONGOING FROM W-E. THUS...DESPITE THE PRECEDING ONGOING TSTMS IN THE TWIN CITIES METRO...THE AVAILABLE INSTABILITY AND STRONG LOW LEVEL WAA WIND PROFILE AT WSR-88D CHANHASSEN MN SHOULD SUSTAIN THE RELATIVELY FAST MOVING BOW INTO AND THROUGH THE TWIN CITIES CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS THROUGH 0930Z. ..PETERS.. 06/21/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW SVR TSTM WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED SOON FOR PARTS OF WI...SERN MN AND NERN IA FOR A THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL INTO THIS MORNING. DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN A THREAT ACROSS WEST CENTRAL WI AND PART OF SERN MN /SOUTH OF THE TWIN CITIES METRO/ EARLY THIS MORNING AS A 40-50 KT ESEWD MOVING BOWING TSTM LINE MOVES THROUGH THESE AREAS. A FEW HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH STORMS DEVELOPING OVER NERN IA INTO WEST CENTRAL WI IN ADVANCE OF THE BOW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 10Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED THE NRN EXTENT OF THE BOW...AND THE FASTEST FORWARD SPEED OF 50 KT...EXTENDED FROM ERN BARRON AND DUNN COUNTIES IN WEST CENTRAL WI. TRENDS IN THE WSR-88D CHANHASSEN MN INDICATED A 50-65 KT WLY REAR INFLOW JET ATTENDANT TO THIS WELL-DEFINED BOW...WHILE HEAVY RAIN WITH THIS SYSTEM WAS APPARENTLY ENHANCING THE COLD POOL. ALTHOUGH THE TRAILING PORTION OF THE LINE IN SERN MN WAS MOVING SLOWER /SEWD AT 30-35 KT/...A RECENT WIND GUST AT KOWA OF 45 KT AT 0954Z SUGGESTS THE INCREASE IN TSTM INTENSITY/COVERAGE ACROSS SERN TO SOUTH CENTRAL MN MAY BE ESTABLISHING A SRN EXTENT OF THE COLD POOL. GIVEN THE WELL ESTABLISHED BOWING TSTM LINE WITH A LARGE MCS ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY...A STRONG REAR INFLOW JET AND CONTINUED DEVELOPMENT OF A COLD POOL...THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED TO SPREAD E AND SE OF WW 332.
